User asks: should we use a stronger model? Their opinion: maybe lots of competitors.

Good question. Let me give a data-driven answer and decide.

Facts:
- Judge is z-ai/glm-5.3-flash (house judge) comparing screenshots + source outline.
- gta6-01: 100 paid places, pot $1666, min place $4, #1 $500.
- Entries: currently 0 (as of 14:20). Deadline Nov 24.
- Model cost on obscurify: deepseek flash ~$0.0003/req, glm-5.3-flash ~$0.0003, claude-opus ~$0.0004 (short prompt) but much more for long contexts; gpt-6-astra $0.0748/req (expensive).

For a big build, context grows; costs scale with tokens. Let me actually measure cost per model on a realistic request (large prompt ~20k tokens) to compare.

Also quality: for building a 3D game, stronger models (claude-opus/gpt-5.x/glm-5) produce better code. glm-5.3-flash is a "flash" model — fast but weaker.

Recommendation: use a strong model for the build (e.g., claude-sonnet-5 or gpt-5.2), because:
- Prize is up to $500; cost maybe $5-20 in obscurify credit — worth it.
- The judge only sees screenshots + outline: quality of visuals matters most.

But caution: opencode + obscurify + claude model — need anthropic-compatible path? opencode uses @ai-sdk/openai-compatible with /chat/completions; obscurify accepts anthropic/* model ids on OpenAI endpoint? Let me test: model "anthropic/claude-sonnet-5" via OpenAI chat completions → should work since obscurify routes all models through OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

Let me test a couple of strong models with opencode: `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5`, `openai/gpt-5.2`, `z-ai/glm-5.3` (non-flash).

And measure cost per call with realistic size.

Let me do a quick benchmark: for each candidate model, send a realistic coding prompt (~3000 tokens) and record cost + latency.

Then decide: probably claude-sonnet-5 or gpt-5.2 for main build, glm-5.3-flash for cheap iterations.

Let me run the benchmark now. Also the sleep was interrupted — time is now ~14:45. Need to check.

Let me run benchmark and check time.

action.command:
date -u; cd /workspace/project && timeout 300 python3 - <<'PY'
import json,urllib.request,time,os
K=open(os.path.expanduser("~/.obscurify_key")).read().strip()
sysmsg="You are a senior game developer writing three.js code. "*40
prompt=sysmsg+"Write a short ES module that spawns 30 traffic cars on a road network with lanes, and returns an update(dt) function. Code only."
cands=["z-ai/glm-5.3-flash","z-ai/glm-5.3","anthropic/claude-sonnet-5","openai/gpt-5.2","deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-uncensored"]
for m in cands:
    body={"model":m,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":prompt}],"max_tokens":700}
    r=urllib.request.Request("https://obscurify.ai/v1/chat/completions",data=json.dumps(body).encode(),
      headers={"Authorization":f"Bearer {K}","Content-Type":"application/json"})
    t0=time.time()
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=120) as x: d=json.load(x)
        u=d['usage']; el=time.time()-t0
        c=(d['choices'][0]['message'].get('content') or '')
        print(f"{m:44} {el:5.1f}s prompt={u['prompt_tokens']:5} compl={u['completion_tokens']:4} cost=${u['cost']:.5f} len={len(c)}")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e: print(f"{m:44} HTTP{e.code} {e.read().decode()[:60]}")
PY
